record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare ROCK_HEAD: Tyrunt (1 star) and Tyrantrum (2 stars). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count (multiplier index) and the atk and def read at cast time. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Deals SPECIAL damage to the cast target equal to Math.round(multiplier x (the caster's current atk + current def)), multiplier 1.2 / 1.2 / 1.5 / 3 by the caster's stars (1.2 for both Tyrunt and Tyrantrum). The figure is requested damage before the usual AP and crit scaling; there is no secondary effect, recoil, buff or status. Because atk and def are read at cast time, earlier buffs, items or synergies change it; an armor-reduction status on the caster does not (the raw def field is read).

targeting.note: The caster must reach its target (requiresTarget true). No area or secondary target. Which unit is chosen as cast target is decided by generic targeting code, which was not read.

declaredRaw.label: requested damage = multiplier (by stars) x (caster atk + caster def at cast time)

effects.scaling: requested = the table/formula value. handleSpecialDamage: x (1 + AP/100) because apBoost is true; x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite on the target) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so a crit needs ABILITY_CRIT); other multipliers inside handleSpecialDamage were not re-read for this record. The base figure depends on atk + def at cast time (current values, not the catalog values).
effects.resolution: applied (figure handed to PokemonState.handleDamage) = requested after those multipliers. handleDamage then applies attacker/field/weather multipliers, halves def/speDef first if the target has armorReduction, divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1, and the target's shield absorbs first (with flinch, half of the reduced damage goes to the shield and half to HP). takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp); 0 if the target has protect / skydiving / magicBounce.

starBehavior.note: The multiplier table (1.2 / 1.2 / 1.5 / 3, fallback 3) is indexed by the casting entity's stars; 1 and 2 stars share 1.2, so Tyrunt and Tyrantrum differ only in their atk and def. The 3- and 4-star columns are not reachable by the two listed units' factory star counts.

record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP (floor 0) and deals its damage again, recomputed from the then-current atk and def.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: round(1.2 x (atk + def)) for both listed units, from the caster's current atk and def. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit multiplier, then reduced by the target's SPE_DEF (halved first by armor reduction) with a minimum of 1; takenDamage includes shield damage (and with flinch half goes to the shield) and is 0 when the target has protect / skydiving / magicBounce. No heal, PP gain or shield is involved (shared helper reference: knowledge core-mechanics.md section J).
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Which unit is the cast target and when the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, targeting) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located

Damage resolution after handleDamage's earlier branches (e.g. Shiny Charm, Fossil shield, resurrection, passives, weather and field multipliers) was only partly read: protect, SPE_DEF division, minimum 1 and shield absorption were read; later death handling was not
unresolved: The catalog atk and def of the two units are starting values; the real figure uses atk and def at cast time, which items, synergies and earlier buffs change (not enumerated here)

The damage is computed before handleSpecialDamage; if the target has protect / skydiving / magic bounce the damage is blocked (magic bounce may redirect SPECIAL damage; that branch was not traced) and the ability has no other effect
